2010.title: Part B 图表作文：手机用户量增长情况对比
2010.apply_en:
The bar chart tracks mobile-phone subscriptions from 2000 to 2008. Those in developing countries climbed from 0.5 billion to 4 billion, and those in developed countries went from 0.7 billion to 1 billion as well. The two moved in the same direction, but not at the same pace. The gap between the two widened over the period.

The numbers in the chart are the result of deeper changes. As household incomes have grown, mobile phone use has moved from a luxury to an everyday necessity. Online platforms and mobile payment have made mobile phone use quicker and easier to arrange. People now judge mobile phone use by what it does for them rather than by what others think.

On balance, this is a change worth welcoming. Government can fund public facilities so that mobile phone use is not limited to those who can pay. What matters most is whether families and schools treat mobile phone use as a normal part of life. That is what will decide whether the change lasts.
2010.apply_cn:
该柱状图记录了2000年到2008年期间手机用户数的变化。发展中国家由5亿升至40亿，发达国家也从7亿升到10亿。两者方向一致，但速度不同。两者的差距在这一时期拉大了。

图里的数字，是更深层变化的结果。随着家庭收入提高，手机的使用已从奢侈品变成日常必需。线上平台和移动支付让手机的使用变得更快更方便。人们现在看手机的使用好不好用，而不是看别人怎么想。

总体来看，这是值得欢迎的变化。政府可以投入公共设施，让手机的使用不只属于付得起钱的人。最关键的是家庭和学校把它当成生活的正常一部分，而不是额外负担。而这，正是决定这种变化能否持续的关键。

2011.title: Part B 图表作文：汽车品牌市场份额变化
2011.apply_en:
The bar chart tracks the market shares of Chinese, Japanese and American car brands from 2008 to 2009. Chinese brands climbed from 26% to 31%, while Japanese brands slipped from 35% to 26%. The two moved in opposite directions. The gap between the two widened over the period.

The numbers in the chart are the result of deeper changes. People now judge car ownership by what it does for them rather than by what others think. Public spending on infrastructure has made car ownership far more widely available. Domestic producers have narrowed the quality gap, so buyers no longer pay a premium for foreign brands. Cities have absorbed millions of new residents, and demand for car ownership has grown with them.

On balance, this is a change worth welcoming. Companies can make domestic car brands cheaper and easier to use, so that they reach more people. Clear rules and steady funding matter more than one-off campaigns. That is what will decide whether the change lasts.
2011.apply_cn:
该柱状图记录了2008年到2009年期间国产、日系与美系汽车品牌的市场份额的变化。国产品牌由26%升至31%，而日系品牌由35%降到26%。两者朝相反的方向变化。两者的差距在这一时期拉大了。

图里的数字，是更深层变化的结果。人们现在看汽车保有量好不好用，而不是看别人怎么想。公共基础设施投入让汽车保有量的覆盖面大大增加。国产品牌把质量差距缩小了，消费者不再为外国牌子多掏钱。城市吸纳了大量新居民，汽车保有量的需求随之增长。

总体来看，这是值得欢迎的变化。企业可以把国产汽车品牌做得更便宜好用，让它覆盖更多人。明确的规则和持续投入，比一次性活动更重要。而这，正是决定这种变化能否持续的关键。

2012.title: Part B 图表作文：某公司员工工作满意度调查
2012.apply_en:
The table shows how employee dissatisfaction breaks down. The 41-to-50 age group comes first, at 64%. Those aged 40 or younger and the group over 50 follow, at 33.3% and 10%. The gap between the largest and the smallest is wide. The pattern is clear: a few items dominate the rest.

The numbers in the chart are the result of deeper changes. Longer working hours have made people value the little time they can call their own. Young people change jobs far more often than their parents did, so loyalty works differently. People now judge job satisfaction by what it does for them rather than by what others think.

On balance, the figures point to a problem worth taking seriously. Employers should find out why experienced staff are the least satisfied, not just look at the overall figure. A company that ignores this gap will lose the very people it most depends on. Left alone, the problem will not correct itself.
2012.apply_cn:
该表格展示员工的不满意比例的构成情况。41~50岁组排在第一位，占64%。紧随其后的是40岁及以下组和50岁以上组，分别占33.3%和10%。最大项与最小项之间差距很大。格局很清楚：少数几项占了大头。

图里的数字，是更深层变化的结果。工作时间变长，人们更看重那点属于自己的时间。年轻人换工作比父辈频繁得多，「忠诚」的含义已不同。人们现在看工作满意度好不好用，而不是看别人怎么想。

总体来看，这些数据指向一个不容忽视的问题。雇主应弄清为什么资深员工最不满意，而不是只看总体数字。忽视这一差距的公司，会失去它最依赖的那批人。放任不管，这个问题不会自己好转。

2013.title: Part B 大作文：大学生兼职比例柱状图
2013.apply_en:
The bar chart tracks the proportion of college students taking part-time jobs from the first year to the final year. It rose from 67.77% to 88.24%, with no real dip. Growth was slow at first and then sped up.

The numbers in the chart are the result of deeper changes. Schools now treat part-time work as part of the routine rather than an optional extra. Employers now look for experience as much as for grades. People now judge part-time work by what it does for them rather than by what others think. Young people change jobs far more often than their parents did, so loyalty works differently.

On balance, this is a change worth welcoming. Schools can build part-time work into daily routines instead of treating it as an extra. Families matter most: children copy what adults do far more than what they are told. That is what will decide whether the change lasts.
2013.apply_cn:
该柱状图记录了大一到大四期间大学生兼职比例的变化。它由67.77%一路升至88.24%，中途没有明显回落。增长起初缓慢，后来明显加快。

图里的数字，是更深层变化的结果。学校现在把兼职当成日常安排，而不是可选项。现在用人单位既看成绩，也看经验。人们现在看兼职好不好用，而不是看别人怎么想。年轻人换工作比父辈频繁得多，「忠诚」的含义已不同。

总体来看，这是值得欢迎的变化。学校可以把兼职纳入日常安排，而不是当成额外任务。家庭最关键：孩子模仿大人怎么做，远多于听大人怎么说。而这，正是决定这种变化能否持续的关键。

2014.title: Part B 大作文：城市与乡村人口的变化
2014.apply_en:
The bar chart tracks the urban and rural population from 1990 to 2010. The urban population climbed from 300 million to 670 million, while the rural population slipped from 820 million to 680 million. The two moved in opposite directions. The gap between the two widened over the period.

The numbers in the chart are the result of deeper changes. Cities have absorbed millions of new residents, and demand for city living has grown with them. As household incomes have grown, city living has moved from a luxury to an everyday necessity. Public spending on infrastructure has made city living far more widely available. People now judge city living by what it does for them rather than by what others think.

On balance, this is a change worth welcoming. Government can fund public facilities so that city living is not limited to those who can pay. Clear rules and steady funding matter more than one-off campaigns. What matters most is whether families and schools treat city living as a normal part of life. That is what will decide whether the change lasts.

图里的数字，是更深层变化的结果。城市吸纳了大量新居民，城市生活的需求随之增长。随着家庭收入提高，城市生活已从奢侈品变成日常必需。公共基础设施投入让城市生活的覆盖面大大增加。人们现在看城市生活好不好用，而不是看别人怎么想。

总体来看，这是值得欢迎的变化。政府可以投入公共设施，让城市生活不只属于付得起钱的人。明确的规则和持续投入，比一次性活动更重要。最关键的是家庭和学校把它当成生活的正常一部分，而不是额外负担。而这，正是决定这种变化能否持续的关键。

2018.apply_en:
The pie chart shows how the factors consumers weigh when choosing a restaurant break down. Distinctive features come first, at 36.3%. Service and the dining environment follow, at 26.8% and 23.8%. Other factors round off the list at 4.7%. Taken together, the three largest items make up 86.9%.

The numbers in the chart are the result of deeper changes. As household incomes have grown, dining out has moved from a luxury to an everyday necessity. People now judge dining out by what it does for them rather than by what others think. Online platforms and mobile payment have made dining out quicker and easier to arrange.

On balance, this is a change worth welcoming. Companies can make dining out cheaper and easier to use, so that it reaches more people. Platforms should design simple, honest interfaces instead of ones that keep users hooked. Individuals should choose what fits their own situation rather than follow the crowd. That is what will decide whether the change lasts.
2018.apply_cn:
该饼状图展示消费者选择餐厅时考虑的因素的构成情况。餐厅特色排在第一位，占36.3%。紧随其后的是服务和就餐环境，分别占26.8%和23.8%。最后是其他因素，占4.7%。前三项加起来占86.9%。

图里的数字，是更深层变化的结果。随着家庭收入提高，外出就餐已从奢侈品变成日常必需。人们现在看外出就餐好不好用，而不是看别人怎么想。线上平台和移动支付让外出就餐变得更快更方便。

总体来看，这是值得欢迎的变化。企业可以把外出就餐做得更便宜好用，让它覆盖更多人。平台应把界面做得简单诚实，而不是想方设法让人上瘾。个人应按自身情况选择，而不是随大流。而这，正是决定这种变化能否持续的关键。

2019.title: Part B 大作文：某高校2013年和2018年本科毕业生去向统计柱状图
2019.apply_en:
The bar chart tracks graduates' destinations from 2013 to 2018. The share going on to further study climbed from 26.3% to 34.0%, while the share entering employment slipped from 68.1% to 60.7%. The two moved in opposite directions. The gap between the two widened over the period.

The numbers in the chart are the result of deeper changes. Employers now look for experience as much as for grades. Schools now treat career planning as part of the routine rather than an optional extra. People now judge career planning by what it does for them rather than by what others think. Young people change jobs far more often than their parents did, so loyalty works differently.

On balance, this is a change worth welcoming. Schools can build career planning into daily routines instead of treating it as an extra. What matters most is whether families and schools treat career planning as a normal part of life. That is what will decide whether the change lasts.
2019.apply_cn:
该柱状图记录了2013年到2018年期间毕业生去向的变化。升学比例由26.3%升至34.0%，而就业比例由68.1%降到60.7%。两者朝相反的方向变化。两者的差距在这一时期拉大了。

总体来看，这是值得欢迎的变化。学校可以把职业规划纳入日常安排，而不是当成额外任务。最关键的是家庭和学校把它当成生活的正常一部分，而不是额外负担。而这，正是决定这种变化能否持续的关键。

2022.title: Part B 大作文：2018—2020年我国快递业务量变动情况
2022.apply_en:
The bar chart tracks express delivery volume from 2018 to 2020. The rural figure climbed from 12 billion pieces to 30 billion pieces, and the national total went from 51 billion pieces to 83 billion pieces as well. The gap between the two widened over the period. Growth was slow at first and then sped up.

The numbers in the chart are the result of deeper changes. Technology has cut the cost of online shopping and put it within reach of far more people. Online platforms and mobile payment have made online shopping quicker and easier to arrange. Cities have absorbed millions of new residents, and demand for online shopping has grown with them.

On balance, this is a change worth welcoming. Government can fund public facilities so that online shopping is not limited to those who can pay. Companies can make online shopping cheaper and easier to use, so that it reaches more people. That is what will decide whether the change lasts.

总体来看，这是值得欢迎的变化。政府可以投入公共设施，让网购不只属于付得起钱的人。企业可以把网购做得更便宜好用，让它覆盖更多人。而这，正是决定这种变化能否持续的关键。

2023.apply_en:
The line chart tracks the health literacy rate of Chinese residents from 2012 to 2021. It rose from 8.80% to 25.40%, with no real dip. Growth was slow at first and then sped up. The figure more than doubled over the period.

Schools now treat health literacy as part of the routine rather than an optional extra.

On balance, this is a change worth welcoming. Media should report on health literacy honestly, without exaggerating its benefits or its risks. Clear rules and steady funding matter more than one-off campaigns. Individuals should choose what fits their own situation rather than follow the crowd. That is what will decide whether the change lasts.

2025.title: Part B 大作文：某社区老年人主要日常休闲活动调查（柱形图）
2025.apply_en:
The bar chart shows how the leisure activities of the elderly break down. Watching television comes first, at 90.8%. Taking walks and planting flowers follow, at 68.3% and 34.7%. Playing chess rounds off the list at 18.4%. The gap between the largest and the smallest is wide.

The numbers in the chart are the result of deeper changes. Longer life expectancy has changed how families plan for their later years. As household incomes have grown, retirement life has moved from a luxury to an everyday necessity. People now judge retirement life by what it does for them rather than by what others think. Public spending on infrastructure has made retirement life far more widely available.

On balance, this is a change worth welcoming. Clear rules and steady funding matter more than one-off campaigns. Small habits matter: a little leisure activity every day adds up over a year. What matters most is whether families and schools treat leisure activity as a normal part of life. That is what will decide whether the change lasts.
2025.apply_cn:

图里的数字，是更深层变化的结果。寿命延长，改变了家庭对晚年的安排。随着家庭收入提高，退休生活已从奢侈品变成日常必需。人们现在看退休生活好不好用，而不是看别人怎么想。公共基础设施投入让退休生活的覆盖面大大增加。

总体来看，这是值得欢迎的变化。明确的规则和持续投入，比一次性活动更重要。小习惯很重要：每天一点休闲活动，一年下来就不一样。最关键的是家庭和学校把它当成生活的正常一部分，而不是额外负担。而这，正是决定这种变化能否持续的关键。

2026.apply_en:
The bar chart shows how the perceived benefits of outdoor activities for children break down. Satisfying curiosity comes first, at 54.6%. Improving observation skills and enhancing physical fitness follow, at 54.5% and 33.2%. Strengthening parent-child interaction rounds off the list at 31.2%. The gap between the largest and the smallest is wide.

The numbers in the chart are the result of deeper changes. Sitting all day has turned outdoor activity from a hobby into a practical need. Public spending on infrastructure has made outdoor activity far more widely available. People now judge outdoor activity by what it does for them rather than by what others think. Schools now treat outdoor activity as part of the routine rather than an optional extra.

On balance, this is a change worth welcoming. Families matter most: children copy what adults do far more than what they are told. Schools can build outdoor activity into daily routines instead of treating it as an extra. That is what will decide whether the change lasts.
